training: Global bank D-step, four sampled native 64x64 tiles per TRAIN image; not full-frame optimization
classification: four OVA logistic heads; argmax raw logits; no smoothing/calibration
selection: maximize pooled VAL foreground AP; tie lower complexity; never select on TEST or positive SCSC-CSC differences
ignored: target-class crowds and overlap between target classes; other annotated classes and unannotated regions count as background by project definition
